+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Generate controlled CPU references with optional inductive boundary fields.
+
+The production sources are unchanged. The generated copies retain their flux
+formulations; only boundary parsing/sampling and initial/inflow tangential B
+are extended. This supplies a reference for the accelerated implementation.
+"""
+from pathlib import Path
+import hashlib, json, subprocess
+
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUT=ROOT/'solver/induction_cpu'
+
+def extend(source):
+    start=source.index('struct Boundary{');end=source.index('\nV er(',start)
+    boundary=source[start:end].replace('std::array<double,4>','std::array<double,6>')
+    boundary=boundary.replace('{NAN,NAN,NAN,NAN}','{NAN,NAN,NAN,NAN,NAN,NAN}')
+    needle='  for(auto&r:csv.rows){times.push_back'
+    assert boundary.count(needle)==1
+    boundary=boundary.replace(needle,'  int ieth=csv.col("emf_theta_nT_AU_day",false),ieph=csv.col("emf_phi_nT_AU_day",false);\n'+needle)
+    needle='itemp<0?temp:r[itemp]};'
+    assert boundary.count(needle)==1
+    boundary=boundary.replace(needle,'itemp<0?temp:r[itemp],ieth<0?0:r[ieth],ieph<0?0:r[ieph]};')
+    needle='z[2]*=magnetic_scale;'
+    assert boundary.count(needle)==1
+    boundary=boundary.replace(needle,needle+'z[4]*=magnetic_scale;z[5]*=magnetic_scale;')
+    needle='}return adjust(out);'
+    assert boundary.count(needle)==1
+    replacement='''}
+  // The electric correction belongs to the left map interval. Other fields
+  // above retain linear time interpolation. Outside the map times Br clamps,
+  // so the extra inductive electric field is zero.
+  if(t>=times.front()&&t<times.back()){
+   int interval=ti;
+   for(int da=0;da<2;++da)for(int dl=0;dl<2;++dl){
+    double w=(da?fa:1-fa)*(dl?fl:1-fl);
+    const auto&value=values[((size_t)interval*na+(da?la1:la))*nl+(dl?lo1:lo)];
+    out[4]+=w*value[4];out[5]+=w*value[5];
+   }
+  }
+  return adjust(out);'''
+    boundary=boundary.replace(needle,replacement)
+    source=source[:start]+boundary+source[end:]
+    start=source.index('V mag=add(mul(e,br),mul(az,-boundary.rotation*')
+    end=source.index('double temperature=',start)
+    source=source[:start]+'''// E is in nT AU/day; v is in AU/day. Tangential B advects
+// approximately as 1/r for the flushed initialization, and is exact at rmin.
+double bt=-b[5]/v*1e-9/BUNIT*(rmin/radius);
+double bp=-boundary.rotation*(radius-c.d("source_surface_au",0))*std::sin(th)*br/v+b[4]/v*1e-9/BUNIT*(rmin/radius);
+V mag=add(add(mul(e,br),mul(et(th,ph),bt)),mul(az,bp));'''+source[end:]
+    return source
+
+def main():
+    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    records=[]
+    for infile,stem in [(ROOT/'solver/mhd_solver.cpp','mhd_solver_inductive'),(ROOT/'solver/experiments/mhd_solver_split_glm.cpp','mhd_solver_inductive_split')]:
+        text=infile.read_text();target=OUT/(stem+'.cpp');target.write_text(extend(text))
+        exe=OUT/stem
+        command=['g++','-O3','-std=c++17','-fopenmp',str(target),'-o',str(exe)]
+        subprocess.run(command,check=True)
+        records.append({'base_source':str(infile.relative_to(ROOT)),'base_sha256':hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),
+            'generated_source':str(target.relative_to(ROOT)),'generated_sha256':hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+            'executable_sha256':hashlib.sha256(exe.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'command':command})
+    (OUT/'provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
+    print('Compiled two controlled CPU boundary references.')
+
+if __name__=='__main__':main()
*** End Patch"));
